titre: The shortest game ever… or a myth? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Legend says White resigned after 4 moves. Nobody ever proved this game was played (Gibaud–Lazard, Paris 1924, according to the legend), but the trap is real: chasing the knight lets it fork queen and bishop, and taking it opens the road to mate. Would you have pushed that pawn? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
